S01.name: Canonical leaves and complete admission
S01.remedy: Choose the existing lowest shared owner; seal all safe construction, mutation, Serde and enabled SATS routes. Keep raw rejected DTOs separate.
S01.acceptance: No admitted owner can bypass its actual finite/range/grammar/relation predicate; zero, signed, full-width and namespace policies preserved.

S02.name: P16 physical combat, occurrence and P17 receipts
S02.remedy: Reconcile preserved P16 graph with current P15; retain checked physical leaves, admitted result aggregates and one consumed attack occurrence through equipment, scheduling, contact, health and reports.
S02.acceptance: Full-width occurrence identity; completed attack consumed once; applied cut/blunt channels agree with recording; native extraction only at final kernels/SDK ports; single visible fatigue pool and wheel semantics retained.

S03.name: Source catalogue products and diagnostics
S03.remedy: Put shared vocabulary below build/runtime consumers; admit the actual target representation and a coherent compiled product; retain typed paths/spans and concrete errors to compiler/UI output.
S03.acceptance: Build and runtime accept the same completed schema including optional fields and kind-required capabilities; no f64-to-f32 guarantee assumption; deterministic first errors/source positions preserved.

S04.name: Material, food, inventory, trade and forge conservation
S04.remedy: Carry existing material/volume/mass/fraction/custody owners in associated records and coherent stock quotations through planning, mutation and persistence. Preserve concrete causes and preflight all arithmetic.
S04.acceptance: Exact mass/volume/rounding and ownership conservation; millionths distinct from BPS and aggregate counts; source identity bound to actual inventory object; no saturation presented as checked payable/required quantity.

S05.name: Generated authority, custody and observer knowledge
S05.remedy: Retain opaque validated generation product; separate private/public case identities and immutable blueprint from refreshed custody expectation; type action targets, testimony pipeline and observer-specific knowledge states.
S05.acceptance: All view/action/retry paths share validated provenance; no manual fallback on invalid generated authority; canonical evidence joins; actor personal time used where execution does; sharing never grants firsthand visit.

S06.name: Strategic time, training, weather and interval settlement
S06.remedy: Distinguish absolute clocks, actual settled duration, normalized schedule allocation, study hours and interval applicability; unify complete post-clock settlement across planned/plain paths.
S06.acceptance: Unavailable clock remains distinct from actual epoch0; planned and ordinary paths settle exposure; ambient training uses actual elapsed time; finite stored hours and explicit unbounded ceilings; checked exhaustion and interval metadata.

S07.name: Social, personality, dialogue and inference
S07.remedy: Retain canonical personality/action/fact owners, payload-bearing receipts and observer-scoped availability; derive prose only at presentation; normalize scores with sufficiently wide arithmetic.
S07.acceptance: Truth axes and payloads remain correlated; signed signals/check scales are not forced into UnitInterval; revisions checked before writes; one source of semantic labels; cause and privacy preserved.

S08.name: World events, places, routes and network planning
S08.remedy: Retain canonical event/place/disease and geographic versus abstract coordinate alternatives through planners; unify canonical persistence model; own coherent route request/result/span applicability.
S08.acceptance: No early stringification/re-admission; WGS84 bounds only for geographic branch; exact integer distance and zero elapsed supported; route cache validates before hit; no stale terrain relabeled baseline.

S09.name: Lifecycle, organizations, housing and browser authority
S09.remedy: Use explicit frozen heir, birth preparation, organization membership, unique election and browser provenance products; retain precise identity authority and full-width browser transport.
S09.acceptance: Atomic required preflight before lifecycle side effects; no zero/MAX state sentinels internally; actual kinship source respected; positive payment differs zero balance; verified owner/grant authority distinct from bare character identity.

S10.name: Building accepted geometry and prepared facade
S10.remedy: Separate raw authoring from immutable accepted graph/product; use checked IDs/extents/counts and rebuild correlated supports/geometry atomically; retain framed placement leaves through worker/cache ports.
S10.acceptance: Unique connected IDs; coherent roof/aperture/stair/furniture bounds and supports; checked candidate arithmetic before packed cells; legitimate zero extents and signed geometry preserved; no epsilon/compatibility fallback.

S11.name: Foreign/native resource and tool boundary coordination
S11.remedy: Reconcile exact whole-function ownership with GPU/rig/native partitions; admit coherent resource/count/layout/provenance and parsing progress; retain original native causes through thread/SQL/CLI output.
S11.acceptance: No claim of foreign graph coverage from declaration/import; explicit byte/count/timestep/parse progress boundaries; no error-to-string-to-error reconstruction before terminal output; shared #779/#780/#826 owners coordinated.
